limitations: Photo text presence was reviewed by one assistant before inference, not independently by humans.
Authored screenshots supply exact ground truth but are synthetic and share six layout families.
Fresh cases were frozen before inference; this is a diagnostic addition, not an independent blind study.
Known-positive retrieval labels are incomplete; unknown OCR accuracy remains unknown.
Timing is sequential on one host; sampled process-tree RSS is not system RAM.
The tiny-text additions were used to diagnose the guard; their final scores are development diagnostics, not untouched holdout results.
